title: Pure Gem-Knight

allow.Scatter Fusion: Gem-Knight support the API files under Fusion: it only Fusion Summons non-Rock Gem-Knights, and Gem-Knight Quartz sets it from the Deck.

summary: Pure Gem-Knight Fusion build featuring the 2025 Terminal World wave alongside classic Gem- support and generic staples. Gem-Knight Nepyrim and Gem-Knight Dispersion chain Deck Fusions and extra Normal Summons into Gem-Knight Master Diamond Dispersion, which tags out on either turn for three different non-Rock Gem- Fusions.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gem-Knight Nepyrim searches any Gem-Knight card when Normal or Special Summoned (or when sent from the Deck to the GY) and grants an additional Gem- Normal Summon during your Main Phase.

Gem-Knight Dispersion either Fusion Summons a Gem-Knight using up to 2 non-Rock Gem-Knight monsters from your Deck/Extra Deck (if Gem-Knight Fusion is in your GY, or without that requirement for non-Rocks) or adds any Gem- monster from your Deck or banishment to your hand.
Brilliant Fusion (Limited) and Scatter Fusion send Gem-Knight materials directly from the Deck to the GY to Fusion Summon while triggering GY effects like Nepyrim, Lazuli, and Quartz.
Gem-Armadillo searches a Gem-Knight monster on Normal Summon, while Absorb Fusion searches a Gem-Knight card and optionally Fusion Summons.

summary.title: Opening: Gem-Knight Dispersion or Nepyrim
steps: Summon Gem-Knight Nepyrim (or search it with Gem-Knight Dispersion) to add Gem-Knight Dispersion or Gem-Knight Hollowcore, then use Nepyrim's extra Normal Summon to field another Gem- monster.

Send Gem-Knight Fusion or a Normal Monster to the GY with Gem-Knight Hollowcore to Special Summon it, or fuse from the Deck using Gem-Knight Dispersion (sending Nepyrim and Gem-Knight Lazuli to recover a Normal Monster).

Link Summon Gem-Knight Phantom Quartz to pay 1000 LP and search Gem-Knight Fusion, then shuffle banished/GY Gem-Knights back into the Deck to Fusion Summon Gem-Knight Lady Brilliant Diamond or Gem-Knight Master Diamond Dispersion.
Keep Gem-Knight Fusion in the GY or banish a Gem-Knight from the GY to return it to your hand, repeating Fusions until Master Diamond Dispersion and Hollowcore are set up.

summary.title: Gem-Knight Fusion & Recursion
summary.text: Gem-Knight Fusion has no once-per-turn limit on either effect: you can banish 1 Gem-Knight monster from your GY as many times as you have fuel to return Gem-Knight Fusion to your hand and Fusion Summon again. Sending Gem-Knight Lazuli to the GY by card effect returns a Normal Monster (Garnet, Sapphire, Tourmaline, or Lapis) from the GY to the hand, while Gem-Knight Quartz sets Scatter Fusion when discarded and recovers a Gem-Knight from the GY when used as Fusion Material.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Gem-Knight Master Diamond Dispersion sends itself from the field to the GY as a Quick Effect during the Main Phase to Special Summon up to 3 non-Rock Gem-Monsters with different names from your Extra Deck or GY, ignoring their Summoning conditions (calling Lady Rose Diamond, Aquamarine, Prismaura, Ruby, Citrine, or Topaz).
Gem-Knight Hollowcore banishes a Gem-Knight card from your GY when the opponent activates an effect to negate that effect and boost all Gem-Knight monsters you control by 1000 ATK.
Gem-Knight Lady Rose Diamond protects your Gem-Knights from effect destruction once per opponent's turn and destroys an opponent's card when they activate a monster effect on your turn.

Gem-Knight Master Diamond (Limited) banishes a Level 7 or lower Gem-Knight Fusion from the GY (such as Gem-Knight Lady Lapis Lazuli for massive burn damage or Topaz for double attacks) to copy its name and effects.
